# Animation dependencies

Vendored locally on 2026-10-17; no runtime CDN is required.

- GSAP 3.15.0 and ScrollTrigger 3.15.0, copied from the installed source cache at official GSAP commit `13e2b790546426a1a2e0e9b409f3f8dc6d6611f2`. Original copyright headers preserved. License: https://gsap.com/standard-license . Docs: https://gsap.com/docs/v3/Plugins/ScrollTrigger/ .
- Lenis 1.3.26, dist files from the versioned npm package https://registry.npmjs.org/lenis/-/lenis-1.3.26.tgz . MIT license retained as Lenis-LICENSE.txt. Docs: https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis .

Only GSAP core, ScrollTrigger and Lenis browser runtimes are used. No other plugins are loaded.
